name: Cleanup After Wall Prime
intent: Tear down floor protection and fixture covers, vacuum the floor, final inspect the cured primer, clean tools. Each scenario in Phase 1 stands alone — protection installed by prime is torn down at the end of prime. Phase 1c will introduce cross-scenario protection dedup so that chained prime+finish can share a single setup/teardown lifecycle.
doctrine: Teardown rates are faster than setup rates because removal doesn't require careful seam taping or corner fitting — bunched plastic, tape rips, done. Cleanup is mechanical and modifiers don't apply (a tall room doesn't slow plastic teardown). Tasks gate by application_method so the right teardowns fire for the right method. Final inspect at flat 2000 SF/hr because primer has fewer visible defects than finish.
